Welcome! My name is Will Zatkowski. I go to Lawrence University where I am pursuing a Bachelors in Economics with a Minor in Statistics and Data Science. I am a member of the Lawrence University Investing Club as well as a former member of the Lawrence University Baseball team.

I am from Clarksville Maryland, and as I am a recently retired collegiate athlete, I now enjoy golfing for my exercise.
